Plan and apply workflow cycles under the local authority

Usage: sddk cycle <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start              Create a cycle through the declared `cycle.start` transition
  status             Show the current cycle snapshot and lease
  transition         Apply one declared transition with caller evidence
  evaluate-gate      Authorize and persist one gate evaluation receipt
  rebuild            Restore a missing cycle snapshot from its ledger events
  supersede          Close a cycle with a successor or a reason
  replan             Bounded in-place revision of a cycle
  pause              Pause a cycle, releasing the lease
  resume             Resume a paused cycle, re-acquiring a fresh lease
  artifacts-dir      Print the XDG artifact directory for a cycle (created on demand)
  narrative          Render a deterministic markdown narrative for a cycle (operator view)
  lock               Acquire, release, or inspect the exclusive cycle lease
  inventory          Build the cycle-scoped files inventory artifact (`sddk.inventory/v1`)
  next               Print the frontier of legal transitions from the current cycle state
  verify-references  Verify the provenance chain for a cycle (supports cross-storage drift detection)
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
